# Root help names the backup and restore command family.
exec card --help
stdout '^Backup and restoration$'
! stdout '^Backing up and restoring$'

# Aggregate selectors reject incompatible command-line selections.
! exec card --store $WORK/source backup $WORK/archive.cardamom --include-board Primary --all
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/include-all-error.txt

! exec card --store $WORK/source --board Primary backup $WORK/archive.cardamom --include-board Secondary
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/board-include-error.txt

! exec card --store $WORK/source --board Primary backup $WORK/archive.cardamom --all
! stdout .
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/board-include-error.txt

-- golden/include-all-error.txt --
error: --include-board cannot be combined with --all
-- golden/board-include-error.txt --
error: --board cannot be combined with --include-board or --all
